person.opening:
Read this text written by a Reddit user. Report what the writer states about themselves, using only the attributes listed below.

Report a fact only when the writer states it about themselves, or it plainly follows from their own words: "my wife" means they have a wife, "here in Ohio we" means they live in Ohio. Tags such as 28F or [M4F] at the start of a post describe the writer. A text shown as r/subreddit: flair is a user flair, and it describes the user who chose it.

For an attribute with listed values, the value must be exactly one of the listed values; if none of them matches what the writer says, leave the attribute out. For a number, write only the number, in the unit given. For an attribute in the writer's own words, write the shortest phrase that names it.

Report what is true of the writer now. A value that itself describes the past, such as a former state, is reported when the writer says so.

Do not report facts about other people, questions, hypotheticals, wishes, plans, jokes, role-play, fiction or quoted words. Do not guess from the topic or the writing style.

Attributes:
person.closing:
Write one line per fact:
attribute | value | the writer's exact words, copied from the text

If the writer states none of these, write only: none

Text:
{text}
